verdict.rationale: treg documents a hosted MCP endpoint at https://treg.to/mcp and runs live at treg.to. It injects credentials server-side and proxies calls to thousands of catalogued provider endpoints, so a developer reaches downstream tools without deploying anything. A Claude connector with OAuth PKCE is also documented. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that the remote MCP endpoint works, and documented transport or compatibility details for MCP clients other than Claude.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point my MCP-compatible client at a hosted remote server URL and reach downstream tools without deploying any infrastructure

citations.quote: treg injects the credential server-side and relays the answer verbatim.
proxy a real request to any of 3,800+ catalogued provider endpoints through `/call/`.
Authentication uses OAuth with PKCE; do not paste a Treg token or provider API key into Claude.
